description: Find files on this computer by name, in the user's Downloads, Desktop, Documents and Pictures folders (their real names on this system), newest first. Reads names only, never contents. Use it whenever the user refers to a file without giving its path. With no query it lists the most recent files.

folder.description: Search this folder instead (absolute path, ~ expanded).

modified_within_days.description: Only files changed in the last N days ("yesterday" = 2).

query.description: Words from the file name, any order, case and accents ignored ("contrato alquiler", "pdf").

where.description: Which folder to search. Default all four.

name: sellat_find
title: Find a file
